purpose: Record an outcome-unseen public-source check for an additional high-pressure hydrogen release experiment before considering any new validation protocol.

source.title: Experimental study of pressure dynamics, spontaneous ignition and flame propagation during hydrogen release from high-pressure storage tank through 15 mm diameter tube and exhaust chamber connected to atmosphere
source.reported_apparatus: approximately 0.44 L hydrogen tank, 15 mm x 360 mm tube, pressure/light sensing and high-speed video

search_actions: checked the public publisher article record and DOI metadata
checked targeted public searches for a machine-readable pressure-time archive, supplementary workbook or repository deposit
did not transcribe plotted curves or use article-reported outcomes as validation data
did not alter the frozen model, thresholds or any runtime parameter

decision.next_evidence: Obtain a rights-cleared complete pressure/light/time export and apparatus channel dictionary from the authors or a public repository, then freeze a protocol before opening numerical outcomes.

claim_boundary: This record is a public-access and eligibility recheck only. It does not validate pressure decay, release rate, ignition, flame propagation, consequence distance, station control, or the digital twin.
